performance.verdict: CPL is efficient but GHL pipeline is broken — leads aren't becoming opportunities.

findings.text: 28-day CPL of $12.67 is strong vs July baseline ($19–45/wk range); 3-day lead signal (Oct 8–10: 6+3+5=14) vs prior 3 (Oct 5–7: 12+3+12=27) shows a 48% volume dip on flat spend (~$175 vs ~$271).
3 overdue SOW blockers: extension with Marwan unsigned (due Aug 31), SMS automation not live (due Aug 31), Zoho Voice access not granted (due Aug 31) — all gate CRM follow-up and contract continuity.
3 additional overdue milestones: retargeting seed audience, GBP cadence, and case tracking + GHL auto-logging — all due Sep 30 — remain undelivered, stalling attribution and organic growth.
GHL shows 142 contacts against 167 Meta leads with 0 opportunities created and 0 appointments — leads are arriving but not entering the pipeline; this is an intake/CRM leak, not an ads problem.

GBP actions dropped 31.58% week-over-week (from ~38 to ~26 estimated), and the last 2 days of the series show 0 GBP actions — directional signal of softening organic discovery, consistent with no GBP cadence live.

suggestions.text: Fix GHL intake leak: map Meta leads to opportunities in GHL — 167 leads, 0 opps created is a confirmed pipeline break.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 142 contacts against 167 Meta leads with zero opportunities created and zero appointments booked over the 28-day window — leads are arriving but never entering the pipeline. Audit the GHL lead connector and opportunity-creation workflow this week and confirm the trigger is firing correctly. Success is confirmed when new Meta leads automatically generate an opportunity record in GHL within 24 hours. Re-check by 2026-10-14.

suggestions.text: Watch 3-day Meta lead rate: Oct 8–10 averaged 4.7 leads/day vs Oct 5–7 average of 9/day — re-check Oct 14 before any budget move.
suggestions.monday_update: The last 3 days (Oct 8–10) produced 14 total leads at a spend of ~$175, versus 27 leads on ~$271 spend in the prior 3 days — a 48% volume drop on slightly lower spend. CPL remains strong at $12.67 over 28 days so no budget cut is warranted, but scaling is premature until the dip resolves. Monitor daily lead count and CPL through Oct 14; if the 3-day average returns above 6 leads/day without CPL exceeding $20, a +15% budget step-up is the next action.

suggestions.text: Escalate Marwan extension signing immediately — unsigned contract (overdue since Aug 31) blocks the next 3-month scope and all dependent deliverables.
suggestions.monday_update: The engagement extension with Marwan has been overdue since August 31 and gates the next 3-month term as well as SMS automation and Zoho Voice access — both also overdue. Sohib to contact Marwan directly this week for a signature or a decision call. Success is a signed extension or a clear go/no-go from Marwan by 2026-10-18.
